mapper.select: SELECT p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, p.type, p.color, p.category, p.use_yn AS useYn, p.price, COALESCE(s.quantity, 0) AS quantity, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_stock s ON s.product_code = p.product_code WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.category, p.product_code

SELECT p.product_code AS productCode,p.product_name AS productName,p.type,p.color,p.category,p.use_yn AS useYn,p.price, COALESCE(s.quantity,0) AS quantity,p.created_at AS createdAt,p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_stock s ON s.product_code=p.product_code WHERE p.product_code=#{productCode} AND p.use_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( product_code, product_name, type, color, category, use_yn, price ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{type}, #{color}, #{category}, #{useYn}, #{price} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_name=#{productName},type=#{type},color=#{color},category=#{category},price=#{price},updated_at=NOW() WHERE product_code=#{productCode} AND use_yn='Y'
UPDATE product SET use_yn='N',updated_at=NOW() WHERE product_code=#{productCode} AND use_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO product_stock (product_code, quantity) VALUES (#{productCode}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT quantity FROM product_stock WHERE product_code = #{productCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_stock_history (product_code, type, quantity, balance_after, customer_id, memo, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{productCode}, #{historyType}, #{quantity}, #{balanceAfter}, #{customerId}, #{memo}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT h.stock_history_id AS historyId, h.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, p.color, h.type AS historyType, h.quantity, h.balance_after AS balanceAfter, h.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_name AS customerName, h.memo, h.created_by AS createdBy, h.created_at AS createdAt,h.cancel_yn AS cancelYn,h.cancelled_by AS cancelledBy,h.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt FROM product_stock_history h JOIN product p ON p.product_code = h.product_code LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id ORDER BY h.stock_history_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_stock_history
mapper.update: UPDATE product_stock_history SET cancel_yn='Y',cancelled_by=#{cancelledBy},cancelled_at=NOW() WHERE stock_history_id=#{historyId} AND cancel_yn='N'
mapper.select: SELECT stock_history_id AS historyId, product_code AS productCode, type AS historyType, quantity, balance_after AS balanceAfter, memo, created_at AS createdAt FROM product_stock_history WHERE created_at >= #{start} ORDER BY created_at, stock_history_id

SELECT customer_id AS customerId, customer_name AS customerName, manager_name AS managerName, phone, email, address, memo, use_yn AS useYn, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM customer WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY customer_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (customer_name, manager_name, phone, email, address, memo, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{customerName}, #{managerName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{memo}, 'Y', #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT customer_id AS customerId, customer_name AS customerName, manager_name AS managerName, phone, email, address, memo, use_yn AS useYn, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET customer_name = #{customerName}, manager_name = #{managerName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, address = #{address}, memo = #{memo}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE customer SET use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user
SELECT user_id AS userId, username, display_name AS displayName, role, use_yn AS useYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM app_user ORDER BY user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user(username, password_hash, display_name, role, use_yn) VALUES(#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{role}, 'Y')
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET display_name=#{displayName},role=#{role}, password_hash=CASE WHEN #{passwordHash} IS NULL OR #{passwordHash}='' THEN password_hash ELSE #{passwordHash} END,updated_at=NOW() WHERE username=#{username} AND use_yn='Y'
UPDATE app_user SET use_yn='N',updated_at=NOW() WHERE username=#{username} AND use_yn='Y'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE role='ADMIN' AND use_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(username, action_type, target_type, target_id, details) VALUES(#{username}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{details})
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id AS auditId, username, action_type AS actionType, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, details, created_at AS createdAt FROM audit_log WHERE action_type != 'LOGIN' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE action_type != 'LOGIN' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE action_type = 'LOGIN' OR created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_code AS employeeCode, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.department, e.position_name AS positionName, e.phone, e.email, e.hire_date AS hireDate, e.employment_status AS employmentStatus, e.annual_leave_total AS annualLeaveTotal, e.hourly_wage AS hourlyWage, e.weekly_scheduled_hours AS weeklyScheduledHours, e.weekly_scheduled_days AS weeklyScheduledDays, e.daily_scheduled_hours AS dailyScheduledHours, CASE WHEN e.hire_date IS NULL THEN 15 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.hire_date,CURDATE()) < 1 THEN LEAST(11, GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH,e.hire_date,CURDATE()))) ELSE LEAST(25,15 + FLOOR((TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.hire_date,CURDATE())-1)/2)) END AS annualLeaveRecommended, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.leave_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN l.days ELSE 0 END), 0) AS annualLeaveUsed, e.annual_leave_total - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.leave_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN l.days ELSE 0 END), 0) AS annualLeaveRemaining, e.resume_original_name AS resumeOriginalName, e.resume_stored_name AS resumeStoredName, e.memo, e.created_by AS createdBy, e.updated_by AS updatedBy, e.created_at AS createdAt, e.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_leave_history l ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE e.use_yn='Y' GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.employment_status='ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, e.employee_name

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_code AS employeeCode, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.department, e.position_name AS positionName, e.phone, e.email, e.hire_date AS hireDate, e.employment_status AS employmentStatus, e.annual_leave_total AS annualLeaveTotal, e.hourly_wage AS hourlyWage, e.weekly_scheduled_hours AS weeklyScheduledHours, e.weekly_scheduled_days AS weeklyScheduledDays, e.daily_scheduled_hours AS dailyScheduledHours, CASE WHEN e.hire_date IS NULL THEN 15 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.hire_date,CURDATE()) < 1 THEN LEAST(11, GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH,e.hire_date,CURDATE()))) ELSE LEAST(25,15 + FLOOR((TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,e.hire_date,CURDATE())-1)/2)) END AS annualLeaveRecommended, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.leave_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN l.days ELSE 0 END), 0) AS annualLeaveUsed, e.annual_leave_total - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.leave_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN l.days ELSE 0 END), 0) AS annualLeaveRemaining, e.resume_original_name AS resumeOriginalName, e.resume_stored_name AS resumeStoredName, e.memo, e.created_by AS createdBy, e.updated_by AS updatedBy, e.created_at AS createdAt, e.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_leave_history l ON l.employee_id=e.employee_id WHERE e.employee_id=#{employeeId} AND e.use_yn='Y' GROUP BY e.employee_id
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET use_yn='N', employment_status='RETIRED', updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND use_yn='Y'
mapper.select: SELECT leave_history_id AS leaveHistoryId,employee_id AS employeeId,leave_date AS leaveDate, days,leave_type AS leaveType,memo,created_by AS createdBy,created_at AS createdAt FROM employee_leave_history WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} ORDER BY leave_date DESC,leave_history_id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM employee_leave_history WHERE leave_history_id=#{leaveHistoryId} AND employee_id=#{employeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT payroll_id AS payrollId,employee_id AS employeeId,pay_month AS payMonth, base_salary AS baseSalary,allowance,extra_allowance AS extraAllowance,deduction,net_salary AS netSalary, payment_status AS paymentStatus,payment_date AS paymentDate,memo, created_by AS createdBy,updated_by AS updatedBy,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee_payroll WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} ORDER BY pay_month DESC LIMIT 36
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_payroll(employee_id,pay_month,base_salary,allowance,extra_allowance,deduction,net_salary, payment_status,payment_date,memo,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(#{employeeId},#{payMonth},#{baseSalary},#{allowance},#{extraAllowance},#{deduction},#{netSalary}, #{paymentStatus},#{paymentDate},#{memo},#{createdBy},#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_salary=VALUES(base_salary),allowance=VALUES(allowance),extra_allowance=VALUES(extra_allowance), deduction=VALUES(deduction),net_salary=VALUES(net_salary),payment_status=VALUES(payment_status), payment_date=VALUES(payment_date),memo=VALUES(memo),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM employee_payroll WHERE payroll_id=#{payrollId} AND employee_id=#{employeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT work_allowance_id AS workAllowanceId, employee_id AS employeeId, work_date AS workDate, board_quantity AS boardQuantity, board_unit_price AS boardUnitPrice, board_allowance AS boardAllowance, overtime_hours AS overtimeHours, hourly_wage AS hourlyWage, overtime_multiplier AS overtimeMultiplier, overtime_allowance AS overtimeAllowance, total_allowance AS totalAllowance, attended, memo, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee_work_allowance WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date,'%Y-%m')=#{workMonth} ORDER BY work_date
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_allowance),0) FROM employee_work_allowance WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date,'%Y-%m')=#{workMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_work_allowance(employee_id,work_date,board_quantity,board_unit_price,board_allowance, overtime_hours,hourly_wage,overtime_multiplier,overtime_allowance,total_allowance,attended,memo,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(#{employeeId},#{workDate},#{boardQuantity},#{boardUnitPrice},#{boardAllowance},#{overtimeHours}, #{hourlyWage},#{overtimeMultiplier},#{overtimeAllowance},#{totalAllowance},#{attended},#{memo},#{createdBy},#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE board_quantity=VALUES(board_quantity),board_unit_price=VALUES(board_unit_price), board_allowance=VALUES(board_allowance),overtime_hours=VALUES(overtime_hours),hourly_wage=VALUES(hourly_wage), overtime_multiplier=VALUES(overtime_multiplier),overtime_allowance=VALUES(overtime_allowance), total_allowance=VALUES(total_allowance),attended=VALUES(attended),memo=VALUES(memo),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM employee_work_allowance WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND work_date=#{workDate}
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo,o.customer_id AS customerId,c.customer_name AS customerName, o.product_code AS productCode,p.product_name AS productName,o.ordered_qty AS orderedQty, o.produced_qty AS producedQty,o.defective_qty AS defectiveQty,o.shipped_qty AS shippedQty, o.unit_price AS unitPrice,o.total_amount AS totalAmount,o.order_date AS orderDate,o.due_date AS dueDate, o.order_status AS orderStatus,o.memo,o.created_by AS createdBy,o.updated_by AS updatedBy, o.created_at AS createdAt,o.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN product p ON p.product_code=o.product_code ORDER BY CASE o.order_status WHEN 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, o.due_date, o.order_id DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo,o.customer_id AS customerId,c.customer_name AS customerName, o.product_code AS productCode,p.product_name AS productName,o.ordered_qty AS orderedQty, o.produced_qty AS producedQty,o.defective_qty AS defectiveQty,o.shipped_qty AS shippedQty, o.unit_price AS unitPrice,o.total_amount AS totalAmount,o.order_date AS orderDate,o.due_date AS dueDate, o.order_status AS orderStatus,o.memo,o.created_by AS createdBy,o.updated_by AS updatedBy, o.created_at AS createdAt,o.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN product p ON p.product_code=o.product_code WHERE o.order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET produced_qty=produced_qty+#{goodQty},defective_qty=defective_qty+#{defectiveQty},updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND produced_qty+#{goodQty} <= ordered_qty
UPDATE sales_order SET shipped_qty=shipped_qty+#{shipmentQty},updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND shipped_qty+#{shipmentQty} <= produced_qty
UPDATE sales_order SET order_status='CANCELLED',updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status!='CANCELLED' AND shipped_qty=0
